summary: Anthropic explains how it will apply a SynthID-Text-based watermark to Claude's text (and C2PA content credentials to files) to comply with the EU AI Act's Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-Generated Content.

practices.reason: A forthcoming watermark detection API and C2PA content credentials on generated files are new interfaces engineering teams may eventually need to integrate or monitor, though details are not yet available.

practices.reason: Anthropic describes an internal and third-party (SynthID-Text paper) methodology for testing whether a generation-time technique degrades output quality, using thumbs-up/down ratings and side-by-side human comparisons, but this is the lab's own unreplicated process rather than a transferable instrument.
practices.quote: a controlled study, human raters comparing watermarked and unwatermarked answers side-by-side saw no difference in quality. A
